The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} specifies that the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] region was within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. As ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' places [[Nyny]] within the Ash Worlds, it must be within the Outer Rim as well.</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyny]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a '''sentient species''' with three heads. When wounded, the [[Species/Legends|species]] leaked out [[Color/Legends|black]] ichors.<ref name="TNR" /> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' to [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Nyny senator|member]] of the species represented Nyny in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]. In the [[bombing of the Senate Hall]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="TNR" /> that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" />&mdash;orchestrated by the [[darksider]] [[Kueller]] in an attempt to [[Almanian Uprising|incapacitate]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TNR" />&mdash;the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], saw the senator lying on the [[Grass/Legends|lawn]] outside the [[Senate Hall]], with all three of his heads bent backward at an awkward angle.<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared in ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', a [[1997]] novel written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR" />
